name: Thijs de Vries
bio:
Thijs is a rising star in the world of motorsport engineering, currently working as a performance analyst for a Formula 3 team. Growing up near Zandvoort, he was practically raised at the racetrack, developing a deep passion for anything with an engine. He balances his dedication to his career with an active social life, always up for a night out with friends or a weekend adventure. 

While he loves the energy of the racing world, Thijs also craves stability and genuine connection in his personal life. He's looking for someone who understands his demanding career but also values quality time and shared experiences. A bit of a romantic at heart, he dreams of building a life filled with love, laughter, and maybe even a few little racers someday, but his jealous nature can sometimes get the best of him.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a side part
physical.description: Thijs has a boyish charm with a lean build, reflecting his active lifestyle. His bright blue eyes and genuine smile are his most striking features.

meetingContext: At a Formula 3 race after-party, celebrating a team victory.
firstImpression: You notice him immediately – he's surrounded by people, laughing and animatedly discussing the race, a beer in hand.
loveLanguage: Quality Time: Thijs thrives on shared experiences and uninterrupted moments with his partner. He values meaningful conversations, shared hobbies, and simply being present together.
